why: Advice 1 makes the right call, gets the churn breakeven roughly right (about 3%), and covers practical issues Advice 2 skips: refund policy and locked-in pricing. Advice 2 has sharper deadlines and thresholds, but some of its stop rules are shaky: it would drop the discount if long-tenure customers adopt it, which is exactly who you'd expect to ask for annual billing, and its 25% uptake bar is arbitrary.
